periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Approximately 45-degree downward-oblique angle relative to the horizontal facial axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated ovoid; primary longitudinal axis is approximately 1.7x the vertical axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Marked downward tapering with the lowest point of the patch extending significantly below the geometric center toward the muzzle.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow, broad U-shaped curve along the posterior margin.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: High relative thickness; dark band occupies approximately 30-35% of the visible torso length.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smoothly rounded semicircular contour on the superior boundary of the visible pinna.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible brownish-yellow chromatic transition in the fur of the posterior torso and hindquarters compared to the anterior dorsal white region.
